title: Encoded but Disconnected: Decomposing Vision-Language Model Failures under a Patching Null
abstract: arXiv:2610.00024v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Across three vision-language model architectures (LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B), we report a universal negative finding for mid-layer interpretability. On POPE -- the benchmark common to all three -- the mid layers encode the ground-truth answer in 68-91% of errors, yet this signal is not causally active for the final prediction: residual-stream patching yields 0% non-trivial flip at the layer level on all three architectures, and on two of three at the per-head level (Qwen: 0/12,600 patched forwards). The lone exception, InternVL3 layer-20 head-2, is a non-vocab, self-attending head whose effect is localized to that specific head (p < 1e-4). Despite the null, the errors separate operationally into three failure modes -- Perception Failure, Encoded-but-Disconnected, Prior-Override -- learnable above 60% on all three architectures, and the architecture's prior direction predicts which of two interventions elicits a category

translated_title: 已编码但断连：在修补零效应下分解视觉-语言模型的失败
translated_abstract: 在三种视觉-语言模型架构（LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B）上，我们针对中层可解释性报告了一个普遍的否定性发现。在三种模型共用的基准POPE上，中层在68-91%的错误中编码了真实答案，但这一信号对最终预测并无因果作用：残差流修补在所有三种架构的层级别上产生0%的非平凡翻转，且在三种架构中的两种上，按注意力头级别也是如此（Qwen：12,600次修补前向传播中0次翻转）。唯一的例外是InternVL3的第20层第2号头，这是一个非词表输出、自注意的头，其效应局限于该特定头（p < 1e-4）。尽管存在这一零效应，这些错误在操作上仍可区分为三种失败模式——感知失败、已编码但断连、先验覆盖——在所有三种架构上均可学到60%以上的区分效果，且架构的先验方向可预测两种干预中的哪一种能引出类别。
tldr: 该论文通过激活修补实验发现，视觉-语言模型的中层虽然在大多数错误中已编码了正确答案，但该信号对最终预测并无因果作用，并据此将模型错误操作性地分解为感知失败、已编码但断连和先验覆盖三种可学习区分的失败模式。
en_tdlr: Using activation patching, this paper shows that mid layers of vision-language models encode the ground-truth answer in most errors without causally affecting the final prediction, and operationally decomposes these failures into three learnable modes: Perception Failure, Encoded-but-Disconnected, and Prior-Override.
